items.title: Harbor-UCLA Replacement Program - Revised Project Budget Approval
items.location: W Carson St and S Vermont Ave; Torrance; Los Angeles County; 90502
items.description: On June 25, 2024, the Board approved the revised project budget of $1,755,000,000, an increase of $60,000,000 from the previous Board-approved amount of $1,695,000,000, for the Harbor-UCLA Medical Center Replacement Program.  The approved budget adjustment is not a project under California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), since it is excluded from the definition of a project under Section 21065 of the California Public Resources Code, and is a fiscal activity of government that will not result in direct or indirect physical changes in the environment.

items.description: On July 21, 2026, the Board adopted two change orders for the Harbor-UCLA Medical Center Replacement Program. The approved change orders include design and construction of an auxiliary generator yard at Surface Lot 2 and the utility ductbank and the bridge connecting the new Central Utility Plant to the Surgery/Emergency Building. Work is in accordance with the Environmental Impact Report (EIR) Addendum certified by the Board of Supervisors on February 8, 2022 for the Harbor-UCLA Medical Center Replacement Project. The original EIR was certified on December 20, 2016.
